promise: Data center spend will double to $2 trillion — the world's installed data center base (~$1T) rebuilt as accelerated computing / 'AI factories' within 4-5 years
description: Huang repeatedly predicted the ~$1 trillion global data center installed base would convert to accelerated AI computing (his 'AI factory' thesis) and double to ~$2 trillion over four to five years. Spending has indeed surged (hyperscaler capex ~$600B/yr by late 2025), but the full conversion/doubling is a multi-year prediction that is still unfolding.
evidence: Data Center Dynamics (Feb 14, 2024): 'Nvidia CEO predicts data center spend will double to $2 trillion'
Huang framed data centers as 'AI factories' in GTC 2024 keynote and 2025 earnings calls
CNBC (May 21, 2026): AI spending already topping $1T/yr, per Huang's framing
